description: This file defines the NetsimServer class which is responsible for launching a network simulation server with virtual devices and chips, managing command generation, and setting up FIFOs for radio HALs within the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment.

classes.name: Chip
classes.description: Represents a network chip with input and output FIFOs, capable of appending its JSON representation to a command.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a virtual device with a name and a collection of chips, capable of appending its JSON representation to a command.

classes.name: NetsimServer
classes.description: Main class responsible for setting up and launching the netsim server with configured devices and forwarding commands.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates a list of commands to launch the netsim server and associated proxies.

methods.name: AddDevicesParameter
methods.description: Appends the JSON representation of all devices to a command.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Sets up the devices and FIFOs required for the netsim server based on configuration.

methods.name: MakeFifo
methods.description: Creates a FIFO file for a given device instance and relative path.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the feature, 'Netsim'.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the netsim feature is enabled based on configuration.
